description: This source file implements a WebSocket hub class that manages real-time WebSocket connections per user, allowing for connecting, disconnecting, and broadcasting messages.

classes.name: WebSocketHub
classes.description: Tracks active WebSocket connections per user and provides methods to connect, disconnect, and broadcast messages.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the WebSocketHub with an empty connections dictionary.

methods.name: None connect(self, user_id: str, websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Accepts a WebSocket connection and registers it for a specific user.

methods.name: None disconnect(self, user_id: str, websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Removes a WebSocket connection for a specific user.

methods.name: None broadcast(self, user_id: str, message: dict)
methods.description: Sends a message to all WebSocket connections associated with a specific user.
